decisions.reason: The firm has already invested in tooling, finishing and catalogue placement for this multi-model lever family, and its documentation for planners is still recent, so management will treat weak early visibility as a temporary ramp-up effect and keep it.

The mitred handle family displays the firm's proprietary engineering and design identity, so sunk development costs and the public commitment to architecture-aware design favor continuing despite modest results.

Having already pruned C, E and F, management needs to justify the remaining 2023 launches, and this line is embedded in the coordinated handle families and planning documents, so withdrawing it after two years is unlikely.
